beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Jesus went back to Nazareth, the town that watched Him grow up. He taught in the synagogue.

timing.text: Jesus went back to Nazareth, the town that watched Him grow up.
He taught in the synagogue.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us?

timing.text: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon?
and are not his sisters here with us?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: But the people who'd known Him as a boy couldn't believe. They took offense at Him — and their unbelief became a wall.

timing.text: But the people who'd known Him as a boy couldn't believe.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.

timing.text: A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A prophet gets honored everywhere, He said — everywhere except home. Except among his own relatives. Except in his own house.

timing.text: A prophet gets honored everywhere, He said — everywhere except home.
Except among his own relatives.
Except in his own house.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He could do only a few mighty works there. Not because His power ran out, but because they wouldn't receive it.

timing.text: He could do only a few mighty works there.
Not because His power ran out, but because they wouldn't receive it.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them. And he marvelled because of their unbelief.

timing.text: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.
And he marvelled because of their unbelief.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Even amazement at their doubt didn't stop His mercy.

timing.text: Even amazement at their doubt didn't stop His mercy.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A few sick folk. That is all Nazareth brought Him, and He laid His hands on every one of them. The mercy never shrank down to match the unbelief.

timing.text: A few sick folk.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Faith opens the door. Where people believed, even a little, He worked.

timing.text: Faith opens the door.

card.text: He healed the few who reached out. The door is the same today — believe, and let Him work.
